name: green-level-tracked-open
note: G-LIVE §2.1. An OPEN tracked level (extend.lastbar with max_kept=1, the pair OS2033 admits) samples the LAST bar, not its spawn bar. high[1]=13 at spawn and high[4]=17 at the last bar, so a sample-at-spawn mutant reports 13 and dies here by construction.
